q1.explanationZh: 第三段说 Cawdrey 希望词典能帮助更多人读写，而当时大家看不懂新词，所以他是为了帮人理解新造的词。

evidence.quote: Cawdrey hoped his dictionary would help more people learn to read and write “properly”.

q2.explanationZh: 作者引用 oats 的解释，是为了说明 Cawdrey 对很多词的解释并不准确。

evidence.quote: And for many words, the explanations were inaccurate.

q3.explanationZh: 文中说有些词只用一个词来解释，这样词典更像同义词书，所以选 D。

evidence.quote: This made A Table Alphabeticall more like a book of synonyms than a real dictionary.

q4.explanationZh: 这本词典虽然有很多问题，但有总比没有好，所以最合适的谚语是“半块面包也比没有强”。

evidence.quote: Although Cawdrey’s dictionary had many problems, it was quite popular.

accept: express

q5.explanationZh: 空格前有 cannot，后面接原形，express 表示“表达”。

accept: popular

q6.explanationZh: very 后面要形容词，popular 是“受欢迎的”。

accept: develops
is developing

q7.explanationZh: 从出生到五岁大脑在发育，主语是单数，用一般现在时 develops。

accept: accurate

q8.explanationZh: more 后面要形容词，要表达“更准确”，所以把 inaccurate 变成反义词 accurate。

accept: checked

q9.explanationZh: after I had finished 说明是过去的事，所以用过去式 checked。

accept: properly

q10.explanationZh: 空格修饰 working，要用副词 properly，意思是“正常地”。

accept: didn’t go to bed until midnight
did not go to bed until midnight
didn't go to bed until midnight

q11.explanationZh: not ... until 表示“直到……才”，过去的事用 didn’t go to bed until midnight。

accept: Although the product had many problems
Though the product had many problems
Although the product has many problems
Though the product has many problems

q12.explanationZh: “虽然”用 although 引导让步句，问题多是过去的情况，用 had many problems。

accept: If I come across an English word I don’t know
If I come across an English word that I don’t know
If I come across an English word which I don’t know
If I come across an English word I don't know
If I come across an English word that I don't know
If I come across an English word which I don't know
If I meet an English word I don’t know
If I meet an English word I don't know

q13.explanationZh: if 引导条件句，come across 是“偶然遇到”，不认识的单词用 I don’t know 作定语。

accept: would help more people learn to express their ideas
would help more people to express their ideas
would help more people learn to express their thoughts

q14.explanationZh: 前面是 He hoped，所以从句用 would help，help sb. (to) do sth. 是“帮助某人做某事”。
